title: crepis glomerata
intro: Crepis glomerata, commonly known as Rosy Hawk's Beard, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of fever and sore throat. Therapeutically, Crepis glomerata is used to treat various conditions, including rheumatism, gout, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Crepis glomerata include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
